quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #5
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: Why is it important to keep space between your vehicle and others?

options.text: It prevents distractions from other vehicles.
It gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
It keeps traffic moving at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives you time to react to unexpected situations.
questions.explanation: Space between your vehicle and others gives you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: When should you signal before passing another vehicle?

options.text: Early enough so other drivers know your plans.

questions.correctAnswerText: Early enough so other drivers know your plans.
questions.explanation: Signal early before passing so other drivers have time to know what you plan to do.

questions.question: A traffic light changes from green to yellow as you approach an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to pass through before the red light.
Be ready to stop in the middle of the intersection.
Be ready to stop before reaching the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop before reaching the intersection.
questions.explanation: Yellow means the light will turn red soon. Get ready to stop safely before the intersection.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have text that says no passing.

questions.question: When entering a public road from a driveway or private road, what should you do?

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
You can force your way into traffic.
Other drivers must move to make room for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
questions.explanation: You must yield to cars already on the public road. Wait and merge safely when you can.

questions.question: Can you drive around the gates at a railroad crossing?

options.text: Yes, after the train has passed.
Yes, when the lights stop flashing.
Yes, if other drivers do it.

questions.explanation: Always stop at railroad crossings when you see warning signals. Do not drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: How should you approach a railroad crossing with no flashing lights or gates?

options.text: Be ready to yield to any train.
Speed up to beat any oncoming train.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield to any train.
questions.explanation: Always be ready to yield to trains, especially at crossings without lights or gates. Make sure your entire vehicle can clear the tracks before crossing.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign warn about?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: If someone is injured in an accident, what should you do?

options.text: Move the injured person away right away.
Always leave the injured person where they are.
Do not move them unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
Stay away from the injured person.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not move them unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
questions.explanation: Do not move injured people unless necessary. Moving them incorrectly can cause more harm. Keep them warm and apply first aid. If there is heavy bleeding, apply direct pressure.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs only indicate no passing zones.

questions.question: If your wheels drop off the pavement onto the shoulder, you should:

options.text: Brake hard and turn sharply back onto the pavement.
Stop your car on the edge of the road.
Slow down and carefully turn back onto the pavement.
Keep your speed and turn sharply back onto the pavement.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and carefully turn back onto the pavement.
questions.explanation: If your wheels drop off the pavement onto the shoulder, slow down without hard braking. Turn carefully back onto the pavement. Watch for nearby traffic as you return to the road.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the dividing line is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the passing lane is clear.

questions.question: Two solid yellow lines mean:

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is allowed at the top of a hill.
Passing is allowed during daylight only.

questions.explanation: Yellow lines mean traffic on the other side is moving toward you. Never cross two solid yellow lines to pass from either direction.

questions.question: How can you help prevent rear-end collisions?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots before stopping.
Release the gas pedal to slow down before braking.

questions.explanation: Sudden stops make it hard for drivers behind you to avoid hitting you. Release the gas pedal to slow your vehicle first. Then apply steady brake pressure to stop smoothly and activate your brake lights.

questions.question: The "No zone" is:

options.text: The blind spots around a truck or bus.
A roadway with restrictions on vehicle stereo volume.
The television show that replaced The Twilight Zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spots around a truck or bus.
questions.explanation: Trucks and buses have blind spots on both sides, in the rear, and in front. Cars cannot be seen in these areas. These blind spots are called the "No zone."

questions.question: You must stop for a school bus:

options.text: That is parked on the shoulder with no one inside.
When it approaches you, even if its lights are not flashing.
On a two-lane highway when its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a two-lane highway when its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: Stop when approaching a school bus with flashing red lights that is picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic from both directions must stop until the red lights stop flashing and the stop arm is no longer extended.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle on a two-lane road, you should:

options.text: Return to your lane when there is enough room between you and the vehicle you passed.
Stay in the left lane if you plan to turn left.
Return to the right lane immediately.

questions.correctAnswerText: Return to your lane when there is enough room between you and the vehicle you passed.
questions.explanation: After passing on a two-lane road, return to the right lane when you have enough space between yourself and the vehicle you just passed.

questions.question: When approaching a railroad crossing without signals, you should:

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will not happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At an unmarked railroad crossing, slow down and prepare to stop. Look both ways on all tracks for trains. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance and wait until it passes before crossing.

questions.question: Drivers may not pass from either side of a ____ centerline.
questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line means no one can cross the center to pass from either direction.

questions.question: Larger vehicles have:

options.text: The same blind spots as smaller vehicles.

questions.explanation: The larger a vehicle is, the larger its blind spots. Large trucks and SUVs have areas near their back that you cannot see in their mirrors.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light is coming next.

questions.question: To help prevent crashes, you should:

options.text: Ignore other drivers on the road.
Drive only on side streets and back roads.

questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers surprise other road users. Signal before slowing down, stopping, or turning. Use your horn and emergency lights when needed.

questions.question: A stop sign is shaped like a(n):
questions.explanation: Stop signs are octagonal (eight-sided). This shape is used only for stop signs.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.

questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Look both ways before crossing train tracks. Obey all signs and signals. Trains share the road with cars and bicycles.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings ahead. Watch for trains when you see this sign.
